reviews.body:
I absolutely love this dress.
It’s so comfortable to wear and the fabric it’s quite thick. Definitely not see thru.
I, unfortunately had to return this dress because I received it looking worn out.
I wore it hoping I can ignore that, but it kept bugging me.
So I’m aiming for a replacement.
Besides that, I adore this dress and looking forward to wear it again!

I returned it only because it wasn’t quite what I needed for the occasion I had in mind, but the dress itself is excellent quality. I would definitely recommend it.”
Fit great!! Beautiful color and texture, only critique is that I had to keep adjusting the top throughout the night, and it didnt fit how I wouldve liked. I loved the adjustability.

products.product_name: Sophia dress with velvet bows in tweed
products.search_term: J.Crew Sophia dress with velvet bows in tweed

reviews.body: Kevin’s wife here- I ordered multiple dresses hoping to find the perfect one to wear for my mother’s funeral next week. This came tonight and it’s the one. It’s elegant and tasteful. I’m a true pear shape with smaller upper body/waist and wide hips. This is just beautiful on and because it’s loose and slowly, I won’t be worried about sucking in my stomach or any feeling of being constricted like other fitted dresses. Exactly what I need to survive this day. Elegant, classic and comfortable.

Good quality fabric with enough space to move your arms under the cape. It’s super light weighted fabric. The color is as it is on the picture. Got a lot of compliments. I definitely recommend it if you are looking for an affordable dress and comfortable.
Great dress. Does not wrinkle and looks amazing on.

Inaccurate description and low quality! I ordered this dress but was sent a cut-off t-shirt. I’m so upset that this is completely unusable for my daughter”s birthday now. I’m showing a pic with a dollar bill on it so you can see that it’s roughly the length of three bills. Don’t waste your money!
This dress is gorgeous, it looks spectacular! I love it, I'm going to buy it in all the colors!
Great dress
Unfortunately, as a 5’2, 145 lbs, 4/6, pear-shape, the size small was too big. Especially in the waist.

Great quality!! Sized a tad too small. Great fit too!!

products.product_name: Collection chiffon ruffle dress in space floral print
products.search_term: J.Crew Collection chiffon ruffle dress in space floral print

reviews.body:
I absolutely love this dress. The first thing that happened when I put it on was my husband immediately complimented me, which is always a good sign. It fits perfectly and feels very flattering without trying too hard.

The pattern is exactly my style, and the material is lovely. The chiffon fabric is soft, lightweight, and comfortable, with a nice flow when you move. It doesn’t feel stiff or cheap, and it hangs beautifully thanks to the layered, tiered design. The A-line shape and knee-length cut give it an elegant, feminine look while still being easy to wear.

This is one of those dresses that works for so many occasions, casual outings, church, dinners, events, or even more formal gatherings depending on how you accessorize it. It looks great on its own but also pairs well with jewelry, heels, or wedges.

I do recommend paying close attention to the size chart, especially the bust measurement, as noted. Once you get the sizing right, this dress is a winner. Comfortable, stylish, and confidence-boosting, I’m very happy with this purchase.

Another item for the lady of the house. She doesn't shop in Amazon at all. But when she saw this dress, she wanted it. It's her style. She doesn't like flashy colors. She prefers muted, soft pastels. So this item really appeals to her. She can wear it as is or pair it with a light sweater if jacket if needed.

The material is a little thin, but it's for spring and summer. Who wants thick, heavy and non-breathable clothing during humid and hit temperatures?

The size fits her. It is a little looser than she likes, but it not a major concern. This is not a body hugging dress. Extra room and give in the garment is acceptable in this instance.

Overall, this dream is a winner. The cut or silhouette is flattering to most body types, which makes it easy to style. If there is one suggestion, it would be to add a zipper. If you are younger, pulling a dress over your head and shoulders is not a problem. Bit, as you age, you prefer ease and comfort in and from your clothing.

I like this chiffon dress. The darker pink tone with the floral print looks elegant and refined. The fabric is lightweight and perfect for summer. The fit is boxy but comfortable, giving it a relaxed feel without looking sloppy. Also the knee-length design gives it a modest yet classy look. It works well for both formal occasions and casual wear. Overall, it’s a versatile and beautiful dress.

reviews.body: Love this. I put a black lace under shirt on and it really made it super cute. It is on longer side which I wanted. I also sized up one and glad I did. I'm 5'4 and hit below knees.
It was a good dress except it was to long and small in the top.
True to size. Excellent quality, so much so I bought 3 more.

products.search_term: J.Crew Cable-knit sweater-dress in merino wool

reviews.body: The color was exactly as pictured! The fit is accurate. The workmanship is very high quality. It is absolutely lovely. The Merino wool is soft and doesn't scratch or itch (but I've never had problems with that anyway). It's light weight enough that you can wear it indoors, but it's warm enough to wear outdoors on a cold day. The wool and the weave breathe, but are also warm. Love it! My husband also really likes the one I bought for him (different color, but also as pictured). Very, very nice. (And I used to sell both the hand woven ones and loomed ones like this in an imports store when I was in college, so I know what I'm talking about. I believe it might even be the same manufacturer).

The fabric material of this sweater is a must have! Great quality!
If you want a slim/tailored fit sizing then go for your regular size. If you want a looser fit almost abit oversized but not too oversized (if you know what i mean) then size up.
I’m a Size Small but ordered Medium and I love the way it fits.
I got the Oatmeal color and honestly, it’s everything!
Very comfy, comfortable, and cozy!

In today's age of copies and knock-offs, where the original and fakes are often hard to tell apart, I am often cautious about buying things that claim to be real, but in fact are cheap look-alikes. However, this sweater is truly the real deal, and you can buy it with confidence.

I am very pleased with mine. I got the dark green color, and it fits perfectly. It's not as heavy as some sweaters of this type are, which is great for me because I usually layer the sweater with another shirt and a t-shirt, and if you also wear a coat or jacket, you can overheat really fast -- not fun or healthy! But the weight of this sweater makes it ideal for layering, or just wearing with a t-shirt.

I'd call this a fall - winter - spring weight. The sweater needs to be cared for carefully, otherwise it may stretch out of shape; but this is true of all sweaters of this type. I clean mine as seldom as possible, and really, if you are careful, the sweater should last many years.

I can't think of anything bad or any "cons" about this product. Shipping was pretty fast, the price was great, and the quality, craftsmanship, and details of the sweater speak of a much more expensive item. I'm enjoying mine in this ultra-cold winter, and if you decide to get one, you will be making a good choice!

I'm not sure how to make the "Certified Buyer" tag appear with this review; maybe Amazon does that automatically. But I certainly am a real buyer, and in no way affiliated with the seller, except as a happy customer. God bless!

products.product_name: Smocked maxi dress in cotton voile
products.search_term: J.Crew Smocked maxi dress in cotton voile

reviews.title: Great dress!
reviews.body:
Love this dress! I love in California where is warm most of the year. I was able to wear it this past Sunday to church in the middle of January with a cardigan which I ended up having to take off due to the weather reaching 80°. I'm 6 months pregnant and was able to wear my regular size (large). I have no issues with my growing boobs as the top is very stretchy. I am currently 36 DDD/E and growing! I would probably have to size up as I reach into months 8 & 9 and it is NOT the dress to wear for nursing due to lack of access, but the dress looks so cute with a growing belly and is extremely comfortable and light got this warmer days! The color and print and pretty especially once it's on it kind of all just comes together. I used a tan or camel color cardigan but I can see this color work with other white or apricot. I bought the dress in green with the small floral print.
The length reached just above our around my ankles, I'm 5' 4" with a pregnant belly. The quality is not the best but I knew that. I waited for the price to drop. Amazon now let's you price watch the past 30 & 90 days. I wouldn't buy this dress at the regular price to be completely honest. It washes very well. I hang it up to dry so it releases any wrinkles and it's pretty much ready to wear. Again, the value is there if you wait for the price to drop. I usually add it to a wish list or save for later option and check.

Overall, I think this dress will fit any body type and size!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 20, 2026
reviews.author: Kitty

reviews.title: Fits a larger bust
reviews.body: This dress is true to size. It works well with a larger bust (G). I struggle to find dress that fit my bust and this does. It also looks nice and is comfortable.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 18, 2026
reviews.author: Dana Combs

reviews.title: Floral Smocked Maxi Dress
reviews.body:
I recently added this floral smocked maxi dress to my wardrobe, and it has quickly become one of my favorites. Here’s why:

Design and Style
The dress features a lovely floral print that is both vibrant and tasteful. The smocked bodice provides a flattering and comfortable fit, accentuating the waist while allowing for flexibility. The puff sleeves add a touch of vintage charm, and the high neckline complements the overall modest yet stylish look.

Comfort and Material
Made from a lightweight and breathable fabric, this dress is perfect for warm weather. The material feels soft against the skin and flows beautifully as you move. It’s also very comfortable for all-day wear, making it an ideal choice for various occasions.

Versatility
Whether you’re heading to a casual brunch or a summer wedding, this dress fits the bill. Pair it with sandals for a relaxed day out or dress it up with heels and accessories for a more formal event. The length is just right, reaching down to the ankles, which adds to its elegance.

Overall Impression
This floral smocked maxi dress is a wonderful addition to any closet. It combines style, comfort, and versatility, making it suitable for a range of occasions. If you’re looking for a dress that offers both beauty and practicality, this is an excellent choice. Highly recommended!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 21, 2024
reviews.author: Marcy L McKendry

products.product_name: Ruffle-hem slip dress in dot print
products.search_term: J.Crew Ruffle-hem slip dress in dot print

reviews.body: Lovely dress, nice fit. My husband loved it. I took this on a cruise, it needed no ironing. It washes well.

Cute dress and material and . Nice soft, silky material that’s a little more heavy than just a super lightweight silk. I’m about a size 8 and the medium was a little big on me but I think the small would be too small. Had to return it because it didn’t look cute because it was too baggy.

The fit is amazing! It was super comfortable and the color was absolutely gorgeous. The material is satin-y though so if i got even a drop of water on me (which i did) it was pretty obvious but it also dried up and disappeared in a reasonable time. It’s fitted in all the right spots in my opinion, it didn’t come in on my gut but it accentuated my hips nicely! Great value for price!! I wore it with a cardigan to soften the look, but I loved styling it with my black fur coat and heels for a more classic, bold look!

products.product_name: Mini sheath dress in faux leather
products.search_term: J.Crew Mini sheath dress in faux leather

reviews.body: I just received this dress, and tried it on. Ladies, don't sleep on this dress. It has the feel of leather and looks amazing. I can't wait to wear it to the Christmas Party. They are going to hate me. Lol. Fits perfect, hugs my curves. Seriously, get the dress, thank me later!
Is beautiful! The material is very is nice

The item fits really well and is very comfortable to wear. However, I feel that the quality isn’t quite up to the standard I expected for the price point—it seems a bit cheaper than I had hoped. When I first opened the package, there was also a noticeable, slightly odd smell. Overall, it’s wearable and serves its purpose, but I don’t think it fully delivers on the value compared to what I paid.
This dress is very nice. It’s comfortable and the material is cool. I like the color and the fact that it has pockets.

This is a comfortable dress with the right amount of stretch. You will want to check the size chart. They provide 2 size charts - a US standard and their own size chart. There is a difference!

The buttons don’t gap and the pockets haven’t bunched up. The pockets are in a good place for me. As expected the dress is longer than calf length on me.

The neckline is attractive. I do worry though that the neckline will stretch out. There’s no sewn-in facing at the neckline to prevent this.

Directions show to put in a bag when machine washing and to dry flat. Price I paid is fair for this type of dress.
I love these dresses. They are so comfortable and they look cute on.
